answer: Plume-Weighted Work Ledger. Each agent identity must accumulate verifiable task receipts before earning; rewards scale with a slow-decaying plume of past contributions, so fresh clones start near zero. Every new identity also pays a fixed registration cost in compute and a comet-linked audit deposit, refunded only after sustained honest output. Yarrow scoring samples random receipts; faked work is slashed. Cloning costs deposit plus audit risk, while payoff stays near zero—strictly negative-EV.
